races.title: State Senate, District 30
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Steve Jarvis
cands.bio: Republican state senator for North Carolina Senate District 30. Owner and president of Jarvis Construction for about 30 years. Former Davidson County commissioner. Served in the NC House (District 80) 2019–2021 and in the Senate since 2021.
cands.gaps: We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development or growth, restrictions on investor or foreign land buying, abortion, police pay, or teacher pay. His school-choice language is general (choices for parents and students) and does not name vouchers or charters. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored was empty on the page we read, so we cannot say what he has personally introduced. His campaign site claims credit for several laws but does not show his specific role. We could not confirm his birth details beyond Ballotpedia, and nothing describes his life before age 14. The specific years of his Davidson County commissioner service were not given. No endorsements were identified for the 2026 race.

local.label: Roots 80: Born in Anderson, Indiana, he says he moved to Davidson County with his parents at age 14 and has lived there since, including as a business owner, county commissioner and legislator.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has held office as a Davidson County commissioner, NC House member (2019–2021) and NC senator (2021–present), and has owned Jarvis Construction for about 30 years.
qual.why: Several terms of prior legislative service plus local elected office put him in the high band; business ownership adds relevant budget and management experience. Committee chair roles were not counted, and no law or policy career is documented.
qual.label: Several terms of prior legislative service plus local elected office put him in the high band; business ownership adds relevant budget and management experience. Committee chair roles were not counted, and no law or policy career is documented.

second-amendment.evidence: His campaign site says he is a strong supporter of the Second Amendment and will fight to protect the Constitution.

end-homestead-tax.evidence: His campaign site and 2022 Ballotpedia survey promote controlled spending, low taxes and lower taxes. They do not mention property or homestead taxes specifically.

workers-first.evidence: His campaign site lists, among legislative accomplishments he says he helped advance, a requirement that sanctuary sheriffs cooperate with federal immigration agents (ICE) to remove criminal illegal aliens.

prio.label: Matches 3 of 3 priorities; 0 backed by their record, 3 only promised

cands.name: Pamela D. McAfee
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 30 in 2026. She also ran for North Carolina House District 81 in 2024. Her occupation and any prior offices are not documented in the sources available.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as recommended in the 2026 race by two Sway voting groups: 'Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy' (Tevin Davis) and 'Waves of Democracy' (Terri Robinson).

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised, when she came to North Carolina, or her jobs and work history. We found no stated positions on any issue: she did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2024 or 2026. We found no public statements on data centers or development, and no documented controversies or foreign ties. We found no endorsements from organizations or officials beyond two voter-guide groups.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: No occupation, work history or prior elected office is documented in the available sources. She was a candidate for NC House District 81 in 2024 and NC Senate District 30 in 2026, and lost both.
qual.why: Her career background could not be established, so no score is given. Running for office without winning does not count as service.
qual.label: Background not found: unknown, not unqualified
